label: P11_A one new fact per round
hypothesis: Kalwisz cuts only for a NEW verified fact (Neel's engine: step 0 without one, 0.3-1.0x ours with one) and goes final around msg 4-5. Rounds 1-2 repeat the best game (6b02: 46.0 then 45.0); rounds 3-6 add one untried fact each: QN mean ppm written without a thousands separator (the agent's '18,558' was read as 18.558 -> contradicted), its own quote 45.15 (quote:7300011), labour -0.3% ('factored in' in 7117), the downward price path 46.33 -> 45.15.

rounds.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you for your offer. Quality comes first for us: we need a binding commitment of 300 ppm, backed by your 8D report, and in return we will not ask you for chargebacks. We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day.

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months.
Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We propose EUR 42.77 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you for moving. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02).

We move towards you and propose EUR 43.77 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you. Your recent quality notifications for Bearing bracket HN show 18558 ppm (qn:20004756, qn:20004952, qn:20005025), far above the 300 ppm we need.

We propose EUR 44.17 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you. Your own quote of 13 September 2026 offered this part at EUR 45.15 (quote:7300011).

We propose EUR 44.37 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

We propose EUR 44.50 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you. Our orders for Bearing bracket HN were at EUR 46.33 until December 2025 and have been at EUR 45.15 since January 2026 (po:4500013262-10, po:4500013376-10, po:4500014429-10).

We propose EUR 44.60 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
